parameters.name: HashKeyContextList
parameters.description:
The hash values of files.

> You must specify at least one of the **HashKeyList** and **HashKeyContextList** parameters.

parameters.name: HashKeyList
parameters.description:
The identifiers of files. Only MD5 hash values are supported.

> You must specify at least one of the **HashKeyList** and **HashKeyContextList** parameters.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the file. Valid values:

*   **0**: unknown file
*   **1**: binary file
*   **2**: webshell file
*   **4**: script file

> If you do not know the type of the file, set this parameter to **0**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-file-detect-upload-url --hash-key-list 0a212417e65c26ff133cfff28f6c0000 --type 0 --hash-key-context-list HashKey=30319dd5cee8f894766e479cac170da0 FileSize=2698557 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
